```python
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import io

pdf_path = "testbed/docs/handbook.pdf"
doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)

print("=" * 60)
print("PDF METADATA")
print("=" * 60)
print(f"Number of pages: {len(doc)}")
print(f"Title: {doc.metadata.get('title', 'N/A')}")
print(f"Author: {doc.metadata.get('author', 'N/A')}")
print()

# --- Step 1: Extract text from ALL pages ---
print("=" * 60)
print("EXTRACTED TEXT (all pages)")
print("=" * 60)
all_text = ""
for i, page in enumerate(doc):
    page_text = page.get_text()
    all_text += page_text
    print(f"\\n--- Page {i + 1} ---")
    print(page_text if page_text.strip() else "(no extractable text on this page)")

# --- Step 2: Render first page as image and OCR ---
print()
print("=" * 60)
print("OCR RESULT (first page)")
print("=" * 60)
first_page = doc[0]
# Render at 300 DPI for good OCR quality
zoom = 300 / 72  # 72 is default DPI
mat = fitz.Matrix(zoom, zoom)
pix = first_page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat)

# Convert pixmap to PIL Image
img_data = pix.tobytes("png")
img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_data))

# Save the rendered image
img.save("output/first_page.png")
print(f"First page image saved to: output/first_page.png")
print(f"Image size: {img.size}")
print()

# Perform OCR
ocr_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)
print("OCR Text:")
print(ocr_text if ocr_text.strip() else "(no text detected by OCR)")

doc.close()
'''

print("Script written successfully")

mkdir_result = await run_command("mkdir -p output")
print(mkdir_result)

extraction_result = await run_command("python ./extract_pdf.py")
print(extraction_result)
```
